notes.title: The Volcano is Watching: Free Infernal Map Incoming
notes.content: [h3][b]Noble Kings![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]The time has come to expand the horizons of your royal gaze. [b]Village[/b] and [b]Graveyard [/b]have served as noble proving grounds, but a kingdom such as yours deserves more variety, more peril, and more wonders to conquer. That is why our next step is the addition of a [b]brand new map[/b], a biome unlike anything you’ve ruled before: the [b]Volcano![/b][/p][p][/p][p]With it comes not just a change of scenery, but a whole[b] new set of mechanics, events, bosses, enemies, buildings, [/b]and [b]artifacts[/b] to challenge even the most seasoned monarchs.[/p][p][/p][p]We are aiming to release this update [b]later this year[/b], [b]closer to December[/b]. Development is still at an early stage, so consider this an announcement of direction rather than a royal promise. Things may shift as the fires of creation continue to burn, but rest assured: this is where the development leads us![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Welcome to the Volcano[/b][/h2][p]This time your ruling extends to a precarious settlement built at the foot of a [b]vast volcano. [/b]Officially, you tell your subjects you’re here for[b] rare alloys and valuable ores[/b]. But only your closest advisors know the truth: [b]your true aim is to study the occult, [/b]for sages whisper that volcanoes are gateways to the Infernal dimension. [/p][p][/p][p]You’ve had your share of dealings with demons before (sometimes even at your services) but what if you could speak with one of their [b]Archdukes, [/b]someone higher in the infernal hierarchy? What bargains might such a creature strike? And what blasphemies might you unleash by accepting?[/p][p][/p][h2][b]A Realm of New Gameplay Possibilities[/b][/h2][p]The map itself will evolve with the [b]volcanic cycle[/b], shifting through around [b]five distinct stages[/b]. These will change[b] not just the appearance[/b], but [b]also the gameplay[/b], keeping every part of the run tense and interesting. And should you play your cards right, you might find yourself negotiating directly with an [b]Archduke of the Inferno[/b]. Will you accept his infernal pact, or reject it and carve your own path without such unholy aid? The choice will be yours.[/p][p][/p][p]To make things more interesting, [b]Threat Levels[/b] on this map will be [b]uniquely tuned[/b]. Much like how Graveyard is unlocked after beating a certain Threat Level, Volcano will require the same. So we think that you will be ready for a new challenge and [b]distinct modifiers[/b]. Expect them to be fiercer than on other maps, shaking up the predictable spikes of difficulty you’ve grown used to.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/NehVCYS.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Infernal Enemies Await[/b][/h2][p]Every new map brings its own host of horrors. Just as zombies shamble across the Graveyard and goblins terrorize the countryside of the Village, the Inferno will send forth its legions to batter down your gates. Expect twisted [b]imps [/b]darting across the skies, hulking [b]demons [/b]pounding at your walls, and relentless waves led by [b]mighty bosses[/b], each with their own agenda, powers, and reasons to see you fail.[/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/50006e44171d4b364457ca33d89e458e81046ce7.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/a609b3b302b7f2cedcc803ecea8c6f9ffc18031c.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][h2][b]Tools to Match the Challenge[/b][/h2][p]But fear not, noble rulers, because with new dangers come new ways to prevail. This update will introduce:[/p][list][*][p][b]Esoteric artifacts[/b] preserved only by the fickle mercy of demons, granting powers unlike anything seen before.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Infernal-themed buildings[/b], expanding your kingdom’s reach in strange and dangerous ways.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Recruitable creatures[/b] from the Infernal realm, willing to serve in your armies… if you dare to command them.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Potentially even new advisors[/b], drawn from otherworldly planes, ready to whisper their cryptic counsel.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/b3479dd067e88b6e9cea3eba265569295b325cff.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/717004958234560ae715268c5755314f74360432.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Events, New Dilemmas[/b][/h2][p]A new map would not be complete without [b]stories and challenges[/b] to match its tone. Expect to see a host of fresh events, each presenting dilemmas to test your judgment. Below you may see an example and also several royal illustrations we are ready to share with you, [b]handcrafted by the court’s best human artists![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/ae64e9fe47cab3bdad127d3eb7da741cfcca88da.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]The nobles of your kingdom whispered in secret, poring over forbidden tomes and hoarding rare ingredients. Their obsession bore fruit - or perhaps fire - when at last they succeeded in summoning a powerful Lord of Hell.[/i][/p][p][i]Bound within a blazing circle, the demon offered them a single wish in exchange for freedom. Unfortunately, your subjects immediately began shouting conflicting demands: eternal life, death to their rivals, unmatched skill in the bedroom - the list went on, and on, and on. Hours passed in bickering while the demon, clearly regretting his career choices, finally reached out to you in desperation.[/i][/p][p][i]Now, Your Majesty, the circle still burns, the nobles still argue, and the demon waits for your word to end this absurd stalemate.[/i][/p][olist][*][p][i]Set the demon free in exchange for the wish[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Kill the cult members and imprison the demon forever[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Blow out the summoning candles and see what happens next[/i][/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][h3][b]And here other royal illustrations:[/b][/h3][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/a2833a2da203740f33b3e02b70e4a7c185a746fc.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/efcb7edb9c2a27cb05c2e593cd44c71ddae89fa5.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/c02ffe9612beb789170bff5046ad92ea63da64a0.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][h2][b]New Music for a New Realm[/b][/h2][p]Alongside the Volcano map, we’ll be adding a full set of [b]new music tracks[/b], created to capture the ominous, fiery atmosphere of the Infernal theme. These tracks will also be added to the [b]Soundtrack DLC[/b] once the update goes live.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3951500/The_King_is_Watching_Soundtrack/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2][b]Free for All Kings[/b][/h2][p]All of this content will be [b]free[/b] [b]for everyone who owns the game[/b]. Consider it a humble token of our gratitude for your overwhelming support and the love you’ve shown our little project.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Until next time! HUZZAH![/b][/p][p][b][i]~ The Hypnohead Team[/i][/b][/p]

notes.title: The King is Answering your Questions: Q&A Part 2
notes.content:
[h3][b]Noble Kings,[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Once again, the royal court has been filled with your questions. We thank you for your curiosity, your passion, and even your unexpected requests! Today we bring you another round of answers straight from the throne. Let us begin, [b]onward!![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/3d21fdf1d919766e5f5bcd82b410cee307c88380.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Any plans to add VO to the game?
[/b]A: We actually prototyped an announcer who would comment on waves and resource shortages. In practice, though, we felt it broke the flow and immersion of the game. For now, we don’t plan to add VO.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Are there plans to add new councillors, maybe through a community challenge?
[/b]A: Yes! We already have about 20 more councillors in prototypes, and some of them will definitely make it into the game over time.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Why can’t the Tavern consume wine to increase morale?
[/b]A: If you mean why wine is always consumed during battle: that’s a balancing decision. Wine provides a strong morale bonus, and we didn’t want to gate it behind a building. Because it’s always consumed, it’s relatively easier to stockpile compared to other high-level resources like meat.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/150106b419cfbabf8c4460cc99231634d21c95fe.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Will there be a barracks that only uses wine, like Viking warriors?
[/b]A: Maybe :)[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Could each King have their own independent advisor setup?
[/b]A: That’s a QoL feature we’d like to add, but it requires a big rework of how advisor choices are stored. So it’s on our list, but low priority.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Why didn’t you tie Threat Level unlocks to specific Kings, so you’d have to replay from scratch with each one?
[/b]A: We discussed this a lot. Both systems have merits. We chose a more liberal system to give players freedom: you can replay each difficulty per King, or jump straight to higher Threat Levels with a newly unlocked King.[/p][p]Achievements for reaching maximum Threat Level still encourage trying each King, though.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/2c9aa66e843f675c76ee7ddb64ed322f04cf86c8.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Why can’t you get more than six spells?
[/b]A: This is a balancing choice to keep spell slots limited. You can increase the limit with a specific advisor, and you can also stack multiple copies of the same spell. This keeps the cap soft while pushing players to actually use the spells and not hoard them.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Will Endless Mode be available in Threat Levels 2, 3, and 4?
[/b]A: We limited Endless Mode to specific Threat Levels so the leaderboards stay fair and easy to follow. That won’t change for now.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Who is your favourite King to play as?
[/b]A: For our lead designer, it’s King Spellus. For our publishing producer, King Saladin. And we’ve all had fun with Baldwin’s grunt builds :)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/15e45ecfff45bc7a77f69bcaa2afd5a58eca034c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Can you remove the restriction of only being able to take each artifact once?
[/b]A: Hm, that’s actually an interesting idea for a councillor ability.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Could you add a button to gather all units at once, like the deploy-all button?
[/b]A: This and also “presets” of units were requested a lot, but even if we add this functionality it’s a low priority improvement for us at the moment.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Could you make the small gold and iron mines more distinct?
[/b]A: We’ll think about it, thanks! We know there’s a popular mod that does exactly this, so it’s worth exploring.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/1bf7ea0ce1c8b6fd2d4b265de2516e1c4c27ad2c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Can you add the possibility to place orders at the trader for specific items?
[/b]A: Not at the moment, it would break the balance of the current system. But we do want to make builds more predictable in the future, so this might change as we refine things.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Is it planned to add the possibility to play as a bad guy?
[/b]A: What makes you think you’re playing as a good guy now? ;) But we will add more ways to feel bad, but cool.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: What was your most useful marketing beat?
[/b]A: Steam Next Fest brought us the largest number of wishlists. But in the long run, pivoting the game more towards roguelike mechanics, and thus making it more marketable, was even more important.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Is there an opportunity to join your team as a QA engineer?
[/b]A: There are two ways to contribute:[/p][list][*][p]We recruit volunteer testers from time to time, so keep an eye on our Discord announcements.[/p][/*][*][p]We’re not hiring QA managers right now, but we are looking for another GameMaker developer to join the project. You can apply on tinyBuild's website.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/d0ab166cad62c5429507f5975073a79aa28a630a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]That is all for today's royal friends. Your questions inspire us, your support strengthens us, and your love for the game keeps our kingdom growing. We will return soon with another scroll of answers. [b]HUZZAH![/b][/p][p][/p][p][i][b]~The Hypnohead Devs[/b][/i][/p]

notes.title: The King is Answering your Questions: Future Plans and Q&A Part #01
notes.content: [p][b]Noble Kings,[/b][/p][p][/p][p]From the very beginning, through development, the demo, and now launch, we’ve tried to listen closely, adapt quickly, and give our best with the [b]limited means of a small team, but always with heart and passion.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Recently, we asked for your feedback again, and the question we saw the most was simple: [b]what’s next for the game, and when[/b]? Before answering, here’s a bit of context.[/p][p][/p][p]We never expected the incredible love and attention The King is Watching has received. As a team of just four working full time, we’ve been blown away by your support. Passing [b]300,000 copies sold in only a few weeks[/b] is a milestone we thought would take years. Thank you for making this possible.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/f7e5e8b50b25c8ab54e829f66bd666f7456ee0bc.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]In the first month after release, we focused on fixing critical bugs (many we could never have found without your reports, thank you!) and adding much-requested quality-of-life features like mid-run saves. Now that we finally have some breathing room, we can start looking ahead. What follows are our current thoughts and priorities, not yet a fixed roadmap. We hope to share a proper one later this month as things become more concrete.[/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/7528671f3f242524d1c5c4899eef3543805d0f5c.gif"][/img][b]What We’re Thinking About Next[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]A New Map[/b]: We have plenty of ideas, from a fresh set of bosses to special mechanics (different from Graveyard), plus themed enemies, events, and buildings. We can only tease for now that it’s shaping up to be a [i]hell[/i] of an addition. This will be [b]free content for everyone[/b]. We’re aiming for a release this year, but can’t promise just yet.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Kings[/b]: Expanding the roster with new rulers, each bringing unique abilities and playstyles. Some of them will be free, some of them will be part of a paid DLC we plan to introduce next year.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improving Build Predictability[/b]: Right now, creating a specific build can be too dependent on luck. While roguelite randomness is part of the fun, we believe players should have more reliable ways to steer their build’s direction. For example, if you don’t get Poor Man’s Shield or Assassins, there should still be ways to make Grunts useful. We have ideas here, but we’ll share more once we’ve tested them.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam Features[/b]: Trading cards, Steam's Rich Presence, and other platform functionality.[/p][/*][*][p][b]More QoL Improvements[/b]: Because smoother play makes for a stronger kingdom![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We’d love to reveal more, but until these ideas harden into concrete plans, we’d rather not overpromise.[/p][p][/p][p]And now… onward to the first part of the Q&A (we got so many questions that we have to divide answers into separate articles)![/p][p][/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/7cec65b6eda809ba6bd2794247836e5f48db1207.gif"][/img][b]The King is Answering: Q&A Part #01![/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b]Q: Could you imagine implementing a co-op mode?[/b][/p][p]A: We would love to, but we don't think it's a good fit for the game as of now due to basically having to rebuild the entire code and balance it for two players. However, never say never: once we are further with the already in-production updates, we will check back on the idea![/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Is there an official wiki? If so, how come I can’t find it? If not, do you plan on working with the community to create one?[/b][/p][p]A: Yes, there is! It's run by the community with some informational support from us. You can find it [url="https://thekingiswatching.wiki.gg/"]HERE[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/91ac69cad842d7b0917c0a71ff5a312bedddbcd5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Hey Hypnohead, love the game!! Is there any interest in adding career and post-game stats?[/b][/p][p]A: Thank you for the kind words! :)[/p][p]We really want to add more stats to the game, but it's a big task and we are currently working on getting other content in-game. But feedback noted![/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Where can I get the soundtrack?[/b][/p][p]A: You can find it for sale on the Steam store at this link: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3951500/The_King_is_Watching_Soundtrack"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]Q: Do you have plans for mobile or console versions?[/b][/p][p]A: Not at the moment, but it's something we will look into in the future and announce separately.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: We want not just to defend, but to attack the enemy castles. Will you add something like this?[/b][/p][p]A: That's in the backlog as one of the ideas for future maps (but not the next one we plan to add).[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Do you plan to experiment with the geometry of the castles and not just do the 5x5 grid? Maybe some T-shaped castles?[/b][/p][p]A: That’s an interesting idea, but we won't be changing the 5x5 field, since it would require rebalancing how the buildings work… like, a LOT. We think the current negative modifiers for the tiles are enough to push people to experiment with layouts.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/4660ae09fc837541e8ddf3d203c0a796192b2515.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: More unique maps and variety? Also are you gonna add the encyclopedia to be available during a run?[/b][/p][p]A: The encyclopedia was made available just a couple of days after you asked in the 1.0.5 update! :)[/p][p]Yes, we want to add more maps, though the first ones won't be too wildly different.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: What do you think of adding to the game something like archer towers or moats to make more defensive options?[/b][/p][p]A: We even had a prototype of a map where you could build extra defenses on certain points (think of sending out builders instead of gravediggers). It was fun, but not enough to make it into the final game. We plan to go back to the drawing board on that idea in the future.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: What are the inspirations for the Kings?[/b][/p][p]A: We worked backwards in the process: we first created the abilities, then King animations, and only after that thought of names for them :)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/887c1cf73e136b236187ccc1023f756d3415a110.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Are you planning to add controller support?[/b][/p][p]A: Yes, we are working on improved UI and control layout for Steam Deck. We want to bring The King is Watching to handheld in a proper fashion. It's already playable, but there's still room for improvement (especially the text size).[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Will the monsters be added to the encyclopedia?[/b][/p][p]A: We know this is a requested feature, so it might be added in the future. Still, we need to choose our priorities right, and the new map looks like a more interesting addition to the game right now.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Could you add shortcuts to everything please? As a player I feel I could play better if I could use the mouse to point on stuff and press the keyboard for the action.[/b][/p][p]A: We definitely will add them, but we're not 100% sure when. And of course, you'll be able to assign keybindings.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Are you planning to release it for macOS users?[/b][/p][p]A: No plans for a macOS version for now.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/755258c7c596635e3de88ee5292772aba4a2b553.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Do you plan on collaborating with other games?[/b][/p][p]A: We regularly add new bundles on Steam, and that will definitely continue.[/p][p]Steam only allows us to display three bundles on the game page at once, which means some collaborations are time-limited. But worry not: if a bundle disappears, it doesn’t mean it’s gone forever! We love working with other amazing games, and some of the most popular bundles might return in the future.[/p][p]If you're referring to deeper, in-game collaborations, that’s something we’d love to explore one day. But for now, there are no firm plans.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: What do you see as more of a priority: the creation of new content or the tweaking of existing content?[/b][/p][p]A: It really depends on when you ask. A month ago, we would’ve said tweaking existing content. Now we’re looking more into adding new things.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: I would like more challenges centered around using certain builds. E.g. only these units, only this class of units, this King with these units only, etc. Will you implement more of this stuff?[/b][/p][p]A: That’s a great idea which we’ve experimented with a bit, but it didn’t quite land.[/p][p]That said, we’re always looking for ways to expand the challenge system, so feedback like yours helps a lot.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: How long did the development process take? How did the number of people working on the game change during development?[/b][/p][p]A: It took us around a year and a half to go from an improved prototype on itch.io to 1.0. And a bit longer if you consider the very first version of the game we made during a Game Jam.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/398d7b7003fc50388789053cd7d660fdf58317be.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]That’s all for today, thank you very much for joining us and see you soon with more of your questions answered! [b]HUZZAH![/b][/p][p][i][b]~The Hypnohead Devs[/b][/i][/p]

notes.title: Update 1.0.4, King Leo and Lesson Learned
notes.content:
[p][i][b]Noble Kings,[/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p]Today we want to address the recent balancing changes to [b]King Leo the Wise[/b] and share some insight into our thinking, alongside a few additional adjustments.
[i](If you're here just for the patch notes, feel free to scroll down. But we'd really appreciate it if you took a moment to read this message.)[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]A Kingdom Off to a Glorious Start[/b][/h3][p]It’s been just a few weeks since [i][b]The King is Watching[/b][/i] launched, and we’re overwhelmed with the response. Many of you have already poured countless hours into the game, conquered high Threat Levels, and shared your wild, creative builds with us. Your enthusiasm has been nothing short of inspiring, and it makes us even more determined to keep building upon this world: more content, more Kings, more units.[/p][p][/p][p]But before expanding the kingdom, we need to strengthen its foundations.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Improving the Foundation[/b][/h3][p]Over the past weeks, we’ve mobilized everyone—seriously, everyone. We’ve spoken with nearly every GameMaker developer we could find, and we’re now in direct contact with the engine’s creators. Together, we’ve made huge strides in identifying technical issues, from crashes to performance. Some bugs still remain, but we’re confident that the new [b]mid-run saving system[/b] is a massive step forward for the stability and playability of the game.[/p][p]That said, there are two big areas left to improve:[/p][list][*][p]⚖️ [b]Fixing critical balance issues[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🛠️ [b]Clarifying UI and core mechanics[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]We started with balance…and that leads us to Leo.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]The Problem with Leo[/b][/h3][p]We’ll be honest: we didn’t balance [b]King Leo the Wise[/b] properly. He was simply too strong. Here's why:[/p][list][*][p]His [b]first ability[/b] had an extremely short cooldown, enabling frequent blueprint sales.[/p][/*][*][p]Selling blueprints rapidly boosted [b]morale[/b], which in turn [b]greatly increased unit damage and resource production[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Players could [b]bypass early-game resource management entirely[/b], a system that’s supposed to be a core part of the challenge.[/p][/*][*][p]On top of that, Leo has one of the best Gaze upgrades and can [b]spawn free units on cooldown[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We want each King to offer unique bonuses and a meaningful challenge. Some will naturally be stronger than others. And we love seeing you break the game with wild builds, whether intentional or not. But Leo was on an entirely different level. Not just compared to existing Kings, but even those we’re planning to introduce in the future.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]"Why Not Just Buff Everyone Else?"[/b][/h3][p]Trust us, we considered it. But buffing everything to match Leo would cause runaway [b]stat inflation[/b] and break the balance of the game in other areas. It would also make it far harder to design future content. So a nerf was necessary.[/p][p][/p][p]We hate nerfing things. And our goal was to do it [b]just once[/b]. But after reviewing your feedback, we agree: we went [b]too far[/b]. This update includes a revised, more balanced version of Leo and several other changes to improve the experience overall.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h3][p][b]King Leo the Wise[/b]’s third ability resource costs have been reverted:[/p][list][*][p]1st use: Wheat 200, Wood 200 → [b]Wheat 100, Wood 100[/b][/p][/*][*][p]2nd use: Wheat 400, Wood 400 → [b]Wheat 200, Wood 200[/b][/p][/*][*][p]3rd use: Flour 250, Metal 250 → [b]Flour 100, Metal 100[/b][/p][/*][*][p]4th use: Flour 600, Metal 600 → [b]Flour 300, Metal 300[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]First ability[/b] cooldown reduced from [b]40s → 30s[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the functionality of artifacts applying productivity seals for [b]Threat Level 8+[/b] runs.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Steam achievements[/b] for completing the game on [b]Threat Level 10[/b] with each King.[/p][/*][*][p]Made various localization and text improvements across multiple languages.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]A Final Word[/b][/h3][p]We want to sincerely thank you for your feedback. Some of it was tough to read, but it showed just how passionate this community already is about [i]The King is Watching[/i]. We share that passion with you, and we’re learning every day how to better shape this game together.[/p][p][/p][p]You’ve helped us learn a valuable lesson: [b]don’t nerf that hard[/b]. We hope future updates will bring only joy, chaos, and crown-worthy moments.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Thank you for your love and support!
~ Hypnohead[/b][/p]

notes.title: Tightly designed new city builder The King is Watching just keeps getting bigger
notes.content:
Overseeing an ever-growing sprawl can be a highlight of city-building games, but the truly memorable moments in everything from Cities Skylines to Frostpunk come from having to build within tight restrictions. It's this concept that new city builder The King is Watching is founded upon, dramatically limiting the space you have to work with at any moment and forcing you to make tough decisions about what to prioritize. Ironically, this formula has proved so popular that the new indie game just won't stop growing on Steam, and developer Hypnohead says there's more to come.

notes.title: The King is Watching: Your Royal Adventure Has Just Begun!
notes.content:
[p]Loyal rulers, your patience has been legendary… and now, [b]your reign truly begins![/b][/p][p][/p][p]After conquering the hearts of over 8,000 brave monarchs during our demo and earning a splendid 97% positive rating, the gates to [b]The King is Watching[/b] stand wide open. As of [b]July 21st[/b], the kingdom awaits your royal decree![/p][p][/p][p]But for those who’ve already set foot in the kingdom, whether in the demo or on day one of release, the adventure has only just begun. The realm grows richer, deeper, and more unpredictable the longer you rule. Allow us to show you what lies ahead when you keep your royal eyes upon the kingdom![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Meet Your Majesties![/b][/h2][p]In [i]The King is Watching[/i], no two rulers are alike. Each King shapes your royal strategy in unique ways. Let us introduce three noble sovereigns among the 7 the game is offering[/p][p][/p][h3][b]King Spellus[/b][/h3][p]
[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXd6AC2vx6bOM0y4IucdLfj9UdDOPP05fd_EgvoCsFDze2XkYM-91PVewve9jR658B3TtPGQoQerwEq6r1S3Lo1vCTaBISDU2JTIOA4sRrgdNnV6Cludlx7K3qbNt5En54N-eQm5?key=zMhv7_F6FXsNdt27X7mLfw"][/img][/p][p][b]
[/b]A wizard-king through and through, Spellus boasts a pointy nose, a snowy beard, and spectacles perched like royal jewels. His magic flows endlessly: he [b]passively generates 1 crystal every 3 seconds[/b], fueling your arcane power. For 25 water, he conjures a [b]random simple spell[/b], and for 10 petrol he’ll grant you a [b]random powerful spell[/b].[/p][p][/p][h3][b]King Leo the Wise[/b][/h3][p]
[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdoYJPoKSqdHVu6hhsVRRLT4TTpy8eEtzP4Du7xbdcm7VniqQMbAmzHOPjPD5Ij9zP9KVlsrWZjd2qRTuU9toQhofi0fArvVvA-KaLABno75Oj9KWzduBtye9VeTjRUbijpMsDU?key=zMhv7_F6FXsNdt27X7mLfw"][/img][/p][p][b]
[/b]Don’t be fooled by his enormous eyes: though they’d look perfect on a royal tapestry, they’re built for seeking secrets. Leo is your master of blueprints. Complete his royal quests and he’ll reward you with [b]three precious building blueprints[/b] of Basic, Established, and Advanced quality for the corresponding defeated bosses.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]King Alucard[/b][/h3][p]
[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXf7S3Ayjh0w6xtPcMKqD5MfoWICCzF0Nz_zjSOvi8b73zU-yA-nrlCRJCVq3AbjUXXPRTeUlCLOKbyEDjL9PMAA5f7-gIkJw5tf2iyDQLq__U41hVJnNtPvxkWFNqxQlxog4mZRfw?key=zMhv7_F6FXsNdt27X7mLfw"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][p]Pale and mysterious, Alucard’s comfort with coffins might concern the court, but his undead armies speak for themselves. His reign revolves around death and rebirth: his living troops slain in battle have a [b]50% chance to rise again as undead[/b]. He can [b]resurrect up to two fallen soldiers[/b] (plus more with upgrades), or [b]elevate two undead warriors to the next fearsome level[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]As for the others… Well, we’ll leave those surprises for you to discover in your royal journeys! Each King wields [b]unique royal powers[/b], unlocked by conquering the in-game challenges![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Face Monstrous Foes
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/29e26ee1b06b86d9ba1568b26e4500b0daa43d07.png"][/img][/h2][p]Beyond your castle walls, danger grows sharper with every reign, bringing you face-to-face with [b]three mighty bosses[/b], randomly drawn from a roster of many monstrous adversaries.[/p][p][/p][p]In the [b]Village Kingdom[/b], you might battle [b]Gorzog[/b], the towering goblin warlord who believes subtlety is for the weak; [b]Margra[/b], his sharper and even more terrifying counterpart; the [b]Hungering Maw[/b], a horrific creature spewing goblins onto the battlefield like a nightmarish fountain; or [b]Venoxia[/b], the terrifying three-headed menace where one head lies, one tells the truth, and the third eats anyone who dares ask the wrong question.[/p][p][/p][p]But that’s not all, because now you will be able to rule over a new kingdom (and face his powerful enemies)! In the [b]Graveyard Kingdom[/b], where undead and spooky creatures room the land, face sinister enemies like the [b]Coven of Eternal Envy[/b], vampiric [b]Lord Draven[/b], the scholarly-yet-lethal [b]Sir Mortifax[/b], or [b]Araknor[/b], the monstrous spider sorcerer.
[/p][p]Each boss fights with unique tactics and devastating powers, ensuring no single “meta” shall rule the realm. Adapt, improvise, and survive![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Build, Expand, and Experiment[/b][/h2][p]Your kingdom’s arsenal has grown mightily since the demo. New royal tools await:[/p][list][*][p][b]Fuel Pump[/b]: Turns wood and water into petrol to fuel powerful new units.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Archmage University[/b]: Unlocks mightier spells than your humble wizard towers ever dreamed of.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sacrificial Stone[/b]: Convert black sheep (literally!) into spell rewards.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ninja Temple[/b]: Train silent assassins to slice your foes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lion Circus[/b]: Raise magnificent griffins—fierce and feathered.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Goose Hydra Nest[/b]: Transform goose knights into terrifying hydra monstrosities.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Your production buildings and troops’ barracks have [b]three tiers of quality[/b], growing in power and rarity as your reign advances!
[/p][h2][b]Events, Progression, and What Lies Ahead[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/f625bf02d5da16f149a41b5ddd0fb88c94251cd3.jpg"][/img]Prepare for [b]new and improved encounters[/b], where your choices have clearer (and sometimes long-lasting) effects on your realm.[/p][p][/p][p]Your kingdom grows across countless runs thanks to expanded [b]meta-progression[/b]. Unlock new Kings, advisors, upgrades, and secrets to make each future attempt more formidable.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Your Throne Awaits![/b][/h2][p]So, noble ruler: if you’ve already sampled the kingdom’s delights in the demo or your first hours of release, know that even grander trials and treasures await. The enemies grow fiercer, your royal toolbox grows broader, and new secrets wait to be uncovered.

And fear not: [b]The King is Watching’s story is only beginning.[/b] We’re planning [b]2–3 post-launch updates[/b], shaped by your royal feedback![/p][p]
Will you press onward and forge your kingdom’s name into legend? Play The King is Watching today![/p][p][/p][p]Join our community on [url="https://discord.gg/7yf97dNPV2"]Discord[/url] to share strategies, conspiracies, and tales of royal triumphs.[/p][p][/p][p][b]The crown is yours to take. HUZZAH![/b][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: New roguelike The King is Watching puts a brutal twist on the city builder genre
notes.content:
One of the most satisfying aspects of any city builder is the total control you have over your people, their tasks, and how they go about them.
Intriguingly, The King is Watching does away with this core tenet because the folks you lord over are shockingly lazy and require constant supervision. Don't believe me? Well, you can see it for yourself because the game is out now on Steam.

notes.title: The King is Watching is Out Now, Time to Rule Your Kingdom! 👑
notes.content: [p][b]You Royal Highness, your kingdom awaits![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Today marks the grand release of [i][b]The King is Watching[/b][/i], our unique [b]roguelite kingdom builder[/b] where everything works only when you look at it. Since the early days of our demo, the kingdom has thrived with your support. Some noble players have spent over 1000 hours on the demo commanding the realm! We couldn’t wait to release the game for all of you to play it![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="cjpJH8nYHaY;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Curious, are you? Then read on, brave ruler![/p][p][/p][h2][b]RTS, or “Real Time Staring”[/b][/h2][p]So, what is The King is Watching all about? The game has one main mechanic: [b]nothing happens in your kingdom unless you’re watching it.[/b] [/p][p][/p][p]From wheat-picking peasants and gold-digging miners to blade-swinging soldiers preparing for battle, your subjects will only work when you are watching them.[/p][p][/p][p]Thus, your eyes become the kingdom’s greatest resource… but they can’t look at everything at the same time! Will you nurture your crops or train your troops? Only the sharpest sighted monarchs shall thrive![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/9b6f00fef6d81cb027dd4db8556884a5769db86f.gif"][/img][/p][h2][b]Eyes on your Kingdom![/b][/h2][p][i]The King is Watching [/i]it’s a roguelite kingdom builder where [b]no two reigns are ever the same[/b]. But how does the game ensure that?[/p][p][/p][p]Aside from gathering resources and fending off waves of goblins and beasts, you will:[/p][list][*][p]Face [b]one of many villainous Bosses[/b] each run, drawn from a pool of mighty fiends like dragons, necromancers, and goblin warlords, each bringing unique tactics to overthrow you.[/p][/*][*][p]Increase the challenge through ever-tougher [b]Threat Levels[/b], where enemies gain new powers, demanding new royal strategies and split-second ruling.[/p][/*][*][p]Adapt thy plans to [b]random blueprints, artifacts, and spells[/b] found during each run: with this you will forge unique builds instead of relying on a single path to victory.[/p][/*][*][p]Choose from [b]multiple Kings, Advisors and unlockable Upgrades[/b], providing always a new challenge to face![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thus is forged the true royal challenge: every run is gonna be a brand-new royal tale![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/9523e48ccf4f2e5fcd23e8d513d00e10895e367c.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]A Kingdom for Both New and Veteran Kings[/b][/h2][p]Whether you're a fresh-faced monarch still learning which end of the sword is which, or a hardened ruler with battle-scarred robes, [i]The King is Watching[/i] welcomes all. It’s easy to pick up (no scroll-reading required!) but has enough cunning strategy and challenge to keep even the most seasoned sovereigns on their toes for generations![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Ready to Rule?[/b][/h2][p][i]The King is Watching[/i] is officially out, with many updates already being whispered in the castle halls![/p][p][/p][p]Want to meet your fellow nobles? [b]Join us on [url="https://discord.gg/7yf97dNPV2"]Discord[/url][/b] to share strategies, screenshots, and argue politely over which advisor is the best (it’s Gustav the duck, obviously).[/p][p][/p][p][b]A Note on Localization:[/b] Some parts of the current localization were translated but have not yet gone through final editing. You may spot a few lines that seem out of context or a bit rough around the edges.[/p][p]If you do, please let us know in the #bug-reports channel on the Discord! Your help is invaluable, noble ruler! 👑[/p][p][/p][p]So wear your best crown, gaze nobly and carve your legacy into the annals of royal history![/p][p][b]HUZZAH!![/b][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2753900/The_King_is_Watching/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

These formidable enemies will force you to adapt your strategy mid-run, but once defeated, they’ll reward you with new tools and relics to make your reign even stronger![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/6ba41d4cb146ce5c69757d3b8f733670976e4f81.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]👑 New Buildings and Troops[/b][/h3][p][b]New Buildings[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Fuel Pump[/b]: Converts wood and water into petrol to power advanced units and structures.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Archmage University[/b]: Casts even mightier spells than your puny wizard towers.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tile Enchanter[/b]: After 30 seconds, enchants the tile it’s built on, granting a production bonus for the rest of the run.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sacrificial Stone[/b]: Sacrifice Black Sheep units on this ancient stone to receive spell rewards in return.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hero's Statue[/b]: Consumes 200 wood to grant permanent stat upgrades to all your troops.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fisherman's Hub[/b] and [b]Animals Farm[/b]: Gather fresh meat for your more... carnivorous forces.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]New Recruitment Structures for New Troops[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Academy of Nature[/b]: Enroll Healer Mages to boost your arcane army’s vitality.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ninja Temple[/b]: Strike your enemies with deadly ninjas.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Druids' Camp of the Bear[/b]: Watch your druids transform into hulking beasts mid-battle.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lion Circus[/b]: Summon majestic Griffins, airborne terrors at your command.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Balloon Bomber[/b]: Recruits a flying Balloon that cannot be attacked, uses petrol to drop bombs damaging multiple enemies. Requires player attention to continue its assault.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Firing Range[/b]: Produces Musketeers, reliable Ranged soldiers.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Geese Training Field[/b]: Trains Goose Riders, powerful Rider/Champion units.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Goose Hydra Nest[/b]: Mutates a Goose Rider into a terrifying Goose Hydra, a Rider/Arcane unit hungry for enemies (and bread).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Explosive Carts Factory[/b]: Creates carts that explode upon engaging with enemies.[/p][/*][/list][p]As you progress through the game, you’ll gain access to [b]three tiers of buildings[/b], with increasingly rare and powerful options becoming available in later stages of your reign.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/c02b9c14227bc77b2ded3709695fb5b7e20cc4db.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]👑 New Kings & Royal Progressions[/b][/h3][p]Choose from a noble roster of [b]seven monarchs[/b], each with their own [b]unique royal abilities[/b]. Some focus on increasing troop morale, others improve your kingdom’s productivity, and others specialize in unlocking additional magic spells.[/p][p][/p][p]These abilities are unlocked by completing [b]Challenges[/b] that ask each King to prove their worth, such as defeating the first, second, and third bosses using that King in a single run.[/p][p]Want an example?[b] [/b]The first king,[b] King Baldwin, [/b]abilities are:[/p][list][*][p][b]Raise Militia[/b]: Summon 3 Peasants to fight for your cause.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Boost Production[/b]: Increases all building production by 40 percent for 10 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Request Tribute[/b]: Grants you 90 resources of your choice.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/1164adfd4eb014456b37fc84dca165f025fab4b3.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]👑 Summon the Council: Meet Your Advisors[/b][/h3][p]Before each reign, you may now choose up to [b]8 from 21 Advisors[/b] to serve in your Royal Council. notes.title: Q&A with The King is Watching Devs!
notes.content:
[b]Loyal rulers, gather around![/b]

Thanks to everyone who's been playing the demo, leaving feedback, and helping us shape the game. We've been getting a lot of questions lately, so we thought it’d be a good idea to put together a little Q&A with the most frequently asked ones to share what’s going on behind the scenes. Let’s get into it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/b7a96bd1bc39bd8695a64d631c47dac61f6ff1b3.gif[/img]

[b]When will the game be released?[/b]
We’re aiming to release it this summer, but it really depends on how development progresses. We're not quite ready to commit to a specific date yet, so no official announcement for now!

[b]How has demo feedback influenced development?[/b]
We gathered a lot of great ideas and feedback from everyone who played the demo. First of all: thank you! We wrote a longer article about it, so feel free to check that out here: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2753900/announcements/detail/542225339665875918?snr=2___]New Demo Results[/url]. 
[b]Short version?[/b] We were moving in the right direction overall, but your feedback helped us focus even more on what really matters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/791a9bdac41173ca949588a0037b10cdc4ea2fcb.gif[/img]
[i](what really matters? Little goblin fishing animations, that’s what hahaha! Nah, we are joking… just a bit)[/i]

[b]How do you feel about the current game balance?[/b]
We think it’s in a pretty good place for the current amount of content! That said, we’re keeping an eye on the wild builds you all are creating and sharing in Steam Communities and Discord. And that’s totally fine: [b]in a roguelike, there should be ways to break the game and feel overpowered![/b] Our goal is to make multiple strategies viable and ensure the process of discovering them through trial and error stays fun. Expect some balance tweaks in [b]version 1.0[/b]!

[b]Will the demo be updated again?[/b]
Right now, we're focused entirely on [b]preparing the game for release[/b]. Updating the demo would slow us down, and we feel the current version already gives a solid idea of what to expect from the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/9d7927e1b717adca91ac808c93d3866dce3ae1f7.gif[/img]

[b]Will you add more keybinding options?[/b]
Yes!

[b]Why can’t you cast spells while paused?[/b]
At the moment, that’s a [b]technical limitation[/b]. We’re considering it as a quality-of-life improvement after launch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/0dd124bb3971a74e9a5612973ef991ea3ee1c8b9.gif[/img]

[b]Is this a remake of a web game? I saw it on Itch.io before.[/b]
 That version was a prototype for [b]The King is Watching[/b]! The project originally started as a [b]Ludum Dare game jam[/b] entry: [url=https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/54/the-king-is-watching]Ludum Dare Page[/url]. 
We liked it enough to create a Steam page and release it as our first demo. You can still find older versions on Itch.io, but the game has improved a lot since then. Because both we and the players enjoyed the idea, we decided to expand it into a full game.

[b]Will it be playable on Steam Deck?[/b]
 We’re aiming to support Steam Deck by release, but if not, it should come in one of the first updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/c102870404cc4d559bd867cd91ac2c9acdee6783.gif[/img]

[b]Will you continue supporting the game after launch?[/b]
We think almost all developers, who love what they are doing, would like to support their games after release. We are not an exception here. We’re planning at least 2–3 content updates after 1.0, adding new content based on what players are enjoying most. Whether we support it beyond the first few months will depend on how the game is received.

Thanks again for all the love, feedback, and support so far. We're super excited about what's coming next for The King is Watching, and we can’t wait to share more with you soon!

notes.title: The King is Watching: Release Plans & What’s Coming Next! 👑
notes.content:
[i][b]Loyal rulers, gather around! [/b][/i]

We are overwhelmed (like by an enemy invasion, but in a good way!) by the sheer amount of feedback we received after Steam Next Fest. Not only have you shared your thoughts and strategies, but over [b]180,000[/b] of you have [b]wishlisted the game[/b]. I would bow to you but the crown would fall (and we don’t want that, do we?)

Our goal today is to share with you what's coming in the 1.0 version. We will also discuss what we want to add to the game after release. To put it simply: [b]more content, more choices, and more ways to rule your kingdom[/b]. With the core of the game polished and stable, we’re expanding and refining it based on your feedback.

[b]Our focus right now is fully on 1.0[/b], but we want to make it clear: this won’t be the end of the journey. While this article is all about what’s coming in the full release, we also plan to continue developing the game beyond launch, [b]so more on that when the time comes![/b]

Let’s dive into the details at once!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/024d0393165eb727883bc1521fe6dd507a7fb623.gif[/img]

[h2][b]A New King, A New Playstyle[/b][/h2]

The King’s current power is to move blocks across the battlefield. With the release version we will introduce at least one [b]new playable King[/b], each with his own unique powers that [b]evolve the gameplay[/b] and change the way you strategize!

[h2][b]The Royal Council: More Than Just Advisors[/b][/h2]

Advisors will be a major feature in the full game, [b]not just for passive bonuses[/b] but as [b]a way to shape your playthrough[/b]. While the core set of buildings and units remains the same, [b]advisors will determine which blueprints and soldiers you can access[/b], allowing you to avoid those that don’t suit your strategy. Think of them as a way to customize your kingdom’s loadout. Choose wisely, as their influence will define your reign!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/f36083c3efb1db1e14d00fabe5219299f45b18c0.png[/img]

[h2][b]Ascension: The Challenge Awaits[/b][/h2]

Think you’ve mastered the kingdom? [b]Think again![/b] Once you finish with the base difficulty, you’ll unlock [b]Ascensions, extra challenge modifiers[/b] that will push even the most seasoned rulers to their limits. Our goal is to have at least [b]7–8 Ascensions[/b], including brutal changes like facing three bosses in a single run instead of two. Now THAT’s a challenge worthy of the most wise Kings!

[h2][b]A New Level: The Undead Rise![/b][/h2]

By 1.0, we’ll be adding [b]at least one more level[/b], and this one comes with a chilling theme: [b]necromancy and the undead[/b]. This cursed land will allow you to mount expeditions to unearth powerful artifacts, all while dealing with new threats, unique bosses, and dark magic. Me? Afraid? Of course not, but we will still look from a safe distance…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/4e07416de235ff43476f995d22bb069a56f57f2d.gif[/img]

[h2][b]More Bosses, More Surprises![/b][/h2]

Currently, the demo has [b]two fixed bosses[/b]… but we want [b]more[/b]! In the full game, your opponent will be [b]randomized[/b] at the start of each run, [b]adding new challenges and twists[/b]. A fortune teller will even forewarn you of the enemy general you’ll face, [b]each one bringing special modifiers to your playthrough[/b]. Some may freeze your buildings. Others will make each wave stronger. And some? They might just resurrect fallen enemies as skeletons. How rude of them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/6ba41d4cb146ce5c69757d3b8f733670976e4f81.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Expanded Events System![/b][/h2]

We’re also enhancing our event system to provide clearer resolutions to your choices. Spared an enemy? Had them “removed” from the equation? The consequences of your royal decrees will be spelled out in greater detail, so you’ll always know exactly what fate you’ve sealed!
We’ve also heard your love for the witty, varied events (and their charming illustrations!), so rest assured: more are on the way!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827188/8f1cd01e1c5aa872b03d5c7cad80f32fed627086.png[/img]

[h2][b]And Of Course More… Everything![/b][/h2]

Expect [b]tons of additional buildings, units, and spells to expand your tactical options[/b]. This is just a glimpse of what we’re planning, so rest assured, there’s much more to come.

We’ll share more details in future updates, but for now, [b]thank you for your support, feedback, and enthusiasm[/b]. Your kingdom awaits, and the future of [b]The King is Watching[/b] has never looked brighter! [b]HUZZAH![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2981670/The_King_is_Watching_Demo/

Loyal rulers, gather ‘round! The kingdom has never been more bustling! Over 240,000 of you have played the demo. [*] [b]Loop Hero Comparisons:[/b] Many of you have compared us to Loop Hero, which is a massive honor. While we’re thrilled with the overwhelmingly positive reviews (97% positive!), we also know there’s still work to do.
[*] [b]Difficulty Adjustments:[/b] Only 30% of surveyed players managed to defeat the boss. We've seen some crazy survival records, but we acknowledge that reaching the end is a bit difficult right now. We'll work on game balancing. But don’t worry, true masochists, we’ve got you covered: the full release will include Ascensions, with extra challenge modes for those who crave suffering.

[*] [b]Encounters:[/b] You liked them! So we’ll be expanding on them. At the very least, we’ll add clearer descriptions of the consequences of your choices. Maybe even some long-term effects!
[*] [b]Meta-Progression:[/b] This will be expanded significantly! Beyond purchasing upgrades, you’ll have to complete specific challenges to unlock new features. [*] [b]More Enemies, More Bosses, More Mayhem:[/b] Expect a greater variety of enemies and multiple bosses per level. Some will debuff extra tiles, others will try to set everything on fire (literally).
[/list]

notes.title: Roguelike city builder The King is Watching has a new demo, and I'm hooked
notes.content:
One of my favorite city building games of all time is Majesty, the self-titled 'fantasy kingdom sim' where you don't actually control your units, but instead take the seat of an all-seeing monarch that just handles all the town management elements. Fitting that concept into a snappy roguelite format is the upcoming small-scale strategy game The King is Watching, and it's just launched an updated demo on Steam. I had a chance to give the latest build a go ahead of its launch, and the loop already has me hooked.

notes.title: The King Is Watching’s free demo turns city building into a brilliant balancing act of feudal surveillance
notes.content:
A watched pot never boils, so they say - ‘they’ presumably all being dead now after having their minds physically melted after hearing the first kettle click in readiness while stubbornly staring in the opposite direction. Yes, yes, it’s a metaphor, but we don’t have time for all that. Your kingdom is under attack by goblins, and the only way to get your useless underlings to chop the wood, till the fields, and train the guards needed to defend it is to provide constant surveillance. The King Is Watching is a minimalist resource-chain-em-up and wave defense goblin-knocker with a brilliant twist. I'm now a little bit obsessed with it, I think, and what is RPS if not a vehicle for chronicling my many fleeting obsessions?
